items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever hear Professor Monetta's uncle had a band? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I heard Allen band. I heard his band a lot of times.

ctx.x: I think they had two of us. I done forgot, I think they had two bands. The band was practically made up though. You know, to play at the funeral, because he was an old musician, and he was a regular musician. He'd get around with everybody. And all the boys would just get together and make a brass band, play at the funeral. But he had a nice funeral that day.
I'm wondering about the bands across the river. That is like the parades and the brass bands. Like Henry Allen had a band. Did you ever hear Professor Monetta's uncle had a band?

Well, I heard Allen band. I heard his band a lot of times. And they had another band over there. And they were all them fellas. I was about, during that time, and I was about around 11, 12 years old. But I know they had the Atlantic band. They had the Pacific band.
